references.text: Martha affirms her belief in the resurrection on the last day, which directly reflects Isaiah's prophecy that the dead will awake and rejoice, even though they lie in the dust.
Daniel describes a future resurrection where some will wake up to eternal life, a concept Martha expresses when she speaks of the resurrection on the last day.
Jesus expands on Martha's affirmation by explaining that all who are in the graves will hear his voice and come out on the last day.
Jesus confirms Martha's faith by stating that he will raise the dead on the last day, as part of God's will.
Jesus repeats the promise of resurrection on the last day, which is the central theme of Martha's statement to him.
Jesus promises that whoever believes in him will live forever and that he will raise them up on the last day, a direct echo of Martha's faith.
